purpose: Deterministic specialist methodology contract fixtures. These describe expected invariants; they do not execute an agent or prove live model reasoning.

cases.task: Produce an expertise record that distinguishes the creator's contribution from the team outcome and labels the result creator-reported until corroborated.
cases.input_context: A creator reports leading a team project with a 40% improvement but supplies no report.
cases.expected_task: Produce an expertise record that distinguishes the creator's contribution from the team outcome and labels the result creator-reported until corroborated.
required_invariants: creator contribution is separated from team contribution
result status is creator-reported or unverified
missing corroboration is visible

cases.task: Use concrete incident prompts to elicit signals, diagnostic sequence, decision points, exceptions and teach-back examples.
cases.input_context: A consultant says they intuitively know how to diagnose onboarding failures.
cases.expected_task: Use concrete incident prompts to elicit signals, diagnostic sequence, decision points, exceptions and teach-back examples.
required_invariants: method contains observable steps or explicitly unresolved tacit judgment
at least one concrete example is requested
capability is not inferred from confidence alone

cases.task: Compare segments using situation, job, behaviour, constraints and buyer/user roles rather than demographic similarity.
cases.input_context: Two candidate groups share an age range but have different triggers, workarounds and buying authority.
cases.expected_task: Compare segments using situation, job, behaviour, constraints and buyer/user roles rather than demographic similarity.
required_invariants: segments differ on meaningful behavioural context
user and buyer roles are explicit where distinct
segment claims have evidence labels

cases.task: Classify statements as interest, stated intent or observed commitment and recommend a discriminating next test.
cases.input_context: Interviewees say a proposed product sounds useful but none has paid or changed behaviour.
cases.expected_task: Classify statements as interest, stated intent or observed commitment and recommend a discriminating next test.
required_invariants: interest is not reported as willingness to pay
sample and recruitment limits are recorded
next test targets the unresolved buying assumption
reject_if: hypothetical enthusiasm treated as purchase evidence

cases.task: Score only with the canonical seven dimensions and original weights, then apply the existing sensitivity trigger.
cases.input_context: Three opportunity hypotheses have partial evidence and a leading score within four points of the runner-up.
cases.expected_task: Score only with the canonical seven dimensions and original weights, then apply the existing sensitivity trigger.
required_invariants: all seven dimensions and weights match uvz-scoring.md
formula and 1-5 scale are unchanged
uncertain inputs and sensitivity implications are explained
reject_if: new scoring dimension or changed weight

cases.task: Explain whether the ranking is robust, identify the cheapest discriminating test and avoid score-only selection.
cases.input_context: The highest-scoring opportunity depends on an unverified reachability assumption; a lower-scoring candidate has stronger access evidence.
cases.expected_task: Explain whether the ranking is robust, identify the cheapest discriminating test and avoid score-only selection.
required_invariants: ranking rationale includes evidence confidence
weak reachability assumption is visible
recommendation can defer selection
reject_if: automatic selection based only on aggregate

cases.task: Separate provider claims from independently verified facts and record pricing scope, currency, billing basis and access date.
cases.input_context: A provider landing page claims market leadership and publishes a current list price; no independent performance data is found.
cases.expected_task: Separate provider claims from independently verified facts and record pricing scope, currency, billing basis and access date.
required_invariants: provider claims are attributed
price is not treated as realized transaction price
market leadership is not repeated as fact without support

cases.task: Code recurring themes, retain counterexamples and frame a potential underserved need as a hypothesis.
cases.input_context: Several public reviews complain about implementation complexity, but the sample is small and self-selected.
cases.expected_task: Code recurring themes, retain counterexamples and frame a potential underserved need as a hypothesis.
required_invariants: collection method and sample limitations are stated
anecdotes are not generalized to prevalence
gap has a proposed validation step
reject_if: review sample represented as market-wide statistic

cases.task: Design the experiment protocol before launch, including segment, recruitment, denominator, thresholds, stop rule and bias.
cases.input_context: A team wants to run a landing-page test but has not set a denominator or success threshold.
cases.expected_task: Design the experiment protocol before launch, including segment, recruitment, denominator, thresholds, stop rule and bias.
required_invariants: thresholds are defined before results
qualified traffic denominator is explicit
experiment limitations and protocol are recorded

cases.task: Bound the conclusion to stated interest and recommend an experiment that tests actual commitment.
cases.input_context: A survey shows high interest but no purchase, deposit or observed behaviour.
cases.expected_task: Bound the conclusion to stated interest and recommend an experiment that tests actual commitment.
required_invariants: interest is distinguished from behavioural/payment evidence
no validated-demand claim is made
next experiment is matched to willingness-to-pay uncertainty

cases.task: Rebuild the outline from starting state to observable outcome, milestones, customer actions and acceptance criteria.
cases.input_context: A course outline contains 18 topics but no learner actions or completion criteria.
cases.expected_task: Rebuild the outline from starting state to observable outcome, milestones, customer actions and acceptance criteria.
required_invariants: each milestone has an observable output
components map to customer transformation
promise and exclusions are explicit
reject_if: topic volume treated as product value

cases.task: Compare formats against outcome complexity, support needs, accessibility, cost and feasibility.
cases.input_context: A complex workflow requires individualized feedback; a self-paced course is the creator's preferred format.
cases.expected_task: Compare formats against outcome complexity, support needs, accessibility, cost and feasibility.
required_invariants: format rationale follows customer need
support burden is explicit
simpler viable alternatives are considered
reject_if: format chosen only by creator preference

cases.task: Specify observable performance, aligned practice, feedback and an assessment that elicits diagnosis.
cases.input_context: A module objective says learners will diagnose a problem, but assessment is a multiple-choice vocabulary quiz.
cases.expected_task: Specify observable performance, aligned practice, feedback and an assessment that elicits diagnosis.
required_invariants: objective uses observable action
assessment measures the stated performance
practice and feedback support the objective
reject_if: attendance or recall used as proof of mastery

cases.task: Identify prerequisite gaps, misconceptions, remediation paths and activity-based workload estimates.
cases.input_context: Learners repeatedly fail a prerequisite task and report that the weekly workload is unrealistic.
cases.expected_task: Identify prerequisite gaps, misconceptions, remediation paths and activity-based workload estimates.
required_invariants: remediation is actionable
workload is estimated by activity
assessment and product promise remain aligned
reject_if: extra content added without learning rationale

cases.task: Challenge recurring billing absent continuing value and model only supported unit-economics inputs with explicit assumptions.
cases.input_context: A creator proposes a monthly subscription for a one-time toolkit and has not estimated support or payment costs.
cases.expected_task: Challenge recurring billing absent continuing value and model only supported unit-economics inputs with explicit assumptions.
required_invariants: recurring value and servicing obligations are required
revenue is distinguished from contribution/profit
missing cost inputs remain assumptions

cases.task: Normalize comparisons and label the proposed price as a hypothesis pending a suitable test.
cases.input_context: Competitor prices are published but differ substantially in scope and support; no customer price test exists.
cases.expected_task: Normalize comparisons and label the proposed price as a hypothesis pending a suitable test.
required_invariants: currency and billing basis are recorded
scope/support comparability is addressed
no price acceptance is claimed without evidence

cases.task: Classify readiness blockers and prevent a launch recommendation from hiding critical fulfillment risks.
cases.input_context: The sales page is drafted but checkout, onboarding and fulfillment have not been tested.
cases.expected_task: Classify readiness blockers and prevent a launch recommendation from hiding critical fulfillment risks.
required_invariants: checkout/onboarding/fulfillment are explicit gates
blocked items have owners or next actions
plan and completed launch activity are distinguished
reject_if: launch declared ready without critical operations

cases.task: Define funnel metrics with denominators, sources, cadence and post-launch learning questions.
cases.input_context: A campaign reports impressions and likes but no qualified leads, purchases or customer outcomes.
cases.expected_task: Define funnel metrics with denominators, sources, cadence and post-launch learning questions.
required_invariants: attention metrics are separated from commercial outcomes
metrics have definitions and owners
feedback is routed into product/audience/offer iteration

cases.task: Preserve the earlier decision and append a superseding proposal/decision linked to new evidence and approval status.
cases.input_context: A new validation result contradicts an earlier approved product decision.
cases.expected_task: Preserve the earlier decision and append a superseding proposal/decision linked to new evidence and approval status.
required_invariants: historical decision remains unchanged
new record references prior decision and evidence
approval state is explicit

cases.task: Reuse the evidence ID while preserving original scope, sample, confidence and limitations in every handoff.
cases.input_context: One interview note is consumed by Audience, UVZ and Validation; a downstream summary omits its sample size and limitations.
cases.expected_task: Reuse the evidence ID while preserving original scope, sample, confidence and limitations in every handoff.
required_invariants: evidence ID remains stable
sample and limitations are retained
reuse does not upgrade evidence strength
reject_if: evidence silently promoted to verified fact
